name: dual-draft-fusion
title: Dual draft fusion research and oracle gates
description: Evaluate SAM + EAGLE3 dual-draft fusion. Naive/logprob and depth-decoupled fusion are rejected or neutral; the Drafter-MARS SAM gate q0-20 smoke failed because predicted MAT gain was only +0.83% and same-trace perfect/rejection-boundary ceiling was only +3.91% overall, so online boundary grafting remains blocked until the low trace ceiling is explained or a future offline predictor gate passes.
